scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A crowded form
scenes.caption: Nikhil drafts a form with a ticket number, damage category, home address and favourite game. Reva asks what the desk does: repair book covers and return them through the teacher, using a separate fictional contact record.
scenes.speech: Nikhil drafts a form with a ticket number, damage category, home address and favourite game. Reva asks what the desk does: repair book covers and return them through the teacher, using a separate fictional contact record.
scenes.dialogue: Useful curiosity is not a collection purpose.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Only what the job needs
scenes.caption: The teacher supplies a clear purpose: identify the job, choose the repair and arrange collection. Volunteers need ticket numbers and damage categories. The teacher alone uses return contacts. A home address and a game preference add nothing to these tasks.
scenes.speech: The teacher supplies a clear purpose: identify the job, choose the repair and arrange collection. Volunteers need ticket numbers and damage categories. The teacher alone uses return contacts. A home address and a game preference add nothing to these tasks.
scenes.dialogue: Remove fields before asking for answers.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: A time limit
scenes.caption: Their classroom policy ends contact retention after the teacher confirms collection and closes any return query. Anonymous totals may remain for planning. Reva records that trigger instead of writing keep forever, then marks who is responsible for carrying out deletion.
scenes.speech: Their classroom policy ends contact retention after the teacher confirms collection and closes any return query. Anonymous totals may remain for planning. Reva records that trigger instead of writing keep forever, then marks who is responsible for carrying out deletion.
scenes.dialogue: A deletion plan needs an owner.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: A second invitation
scenes.caption: A club asks to reuse contacts for public celebration invitations. Nikhil thinks the earlier form submission is enough. Reva notices that the purpose and audience have changed, so the repair permission cannot automatically cover this use.
scenes.speech: A club asks to reuse contacts for public celebration invitations. Nikhil thinks the earlier form submission is enough. Reva notices that the purpose and audience have changed, so the repair permission cannot automatically cover this use.
scenes.dialogue: A new purpose needs a new check.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: An alternative route
scenes.caption: The teacher offers a general school notice through the approved channel, without exporting repair contacts. Families can choose whether to respond. The desk keeps its original promise about use and deletion. The team avoids treating collected information as an unlimited resource.
scenes.speech: The teacher offers a general school notice through the approved channel, without exporting repair contacts. Families can choose whether to respond. The desk keeps its original promise about use and deletion. The team avoids treating collected information as an unlimited resource.
scenes.dialogue: Meeting a need need not mean reusing a list.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Make the data-use card
scenes.caption: Build the minimal form, attach access and deletion rules, then judge a changed request. Connect purpose, audience and retention. Explain which useful summary can remain after the identifying record is removed.
scenes.speech: Build the minimal form, attach access and deletion rules, then judge a changed request. Connect purpose, audience and retention. Explain which useful summary can remain after the identifying record is removed.
scenes.dialogue: Less data can still support the job.
